description: Twelve-band spectrum analyser with a vintage meter display, showing the energy in bands centred at 25Hz, 40Hz, 63Hz, 100Hz, 160Hz, 250Hz, 500Hz, 1kHz, 2kHz, 4kHz, 8kHz and 16kHz

inputs.text: The left channel, or the whole signal when it is the only cable
The right channel, which gets its own meter in each band on the L/R Split setting

notes: the module has no outputs and no panel controls at all; the four levels it can be set to are sliders on the right-click menu
the whole display is drawn with OpenGL, so nothing on it can be clicked for help
menu: Stereo View: Mono Energy, L/R Split — one meter per band from both inputs together, or a separate meter for each input
Display: Dots, Segmented Bars, Solid Bars — chooses what each meter is drawn as
Light Response: Solid, Dynamic, Persistence — Solid holds one brightness, Dynamic brightens with the signal, Persistence leaves an afterglow
Effects: Bloom, Glass, Shimmer, CRT — four display treatments that can be switched on in any combination
Effects Strength: Off, Subtle, Full — sets how strong those treatments are
Theme: Red, Orange, Amber, Green, Light Blue, Vintage Blue, Ivory — chooses the meter colours
Show Labels — turns the frequency labels under the bands on and off
Show Unlit Segments — turns the dark part of each meter on and off
Top — a slider setting the top of the visible level range, -40dB to 0dB, at -12dB to begin with
Bottom — a slider setting the bottom of the visible level range, -120dB to -60dB, at -100dB to begin with
Fall Delay — a slider setting how quickly the band levels fall, 0.01 to 2 seconds
Peak Fall Delay — a slider setting how quickly the peak marks fall, 0.01 to 3 seconds, at 1 second to begin with
